blocks.text: Hadhrat Ja'far bin Tammaam reports that a man once approached Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) and asked, "Tell me about this Nabeedh from raisins that you give people to drink. Is it because of a Sunnah that you are following or do you find this more convenient for yourselves than giving milk and honey?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) replied, "Indeed Rasulullaah ﷺ once came to Abbaas (RA) who was busy giving the people Nabeedh to drink. When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked for something to drink, Abbaas (RA) called for a few cups of Nabeedh and handed one over to Rasulullaah ﷺ. After drinking, Rasulullaah ﷺ remarked, 'You have it prepared well. This is what you should continue doing.' It therefore gives me no pleasure to be a means of giving people milk and honey in place of the statement Rasulullaah ﷺ made when he said, 'You have prepared it well. This is what you should continue doing.'"[^2]
Incidents About How Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Followed in the Footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Ibn Seereen narrates, "I was once with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) in Arafaat. When the people left, I left with him until we reached the Imaam and performed the Zuhr and Asr salaah behind him. My companions and I then stayed there with him until the Imaam left (for Muzdalifah after sunset). We left with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and when we eventually reached a narrow place just before Ma'zamain, he made his animal sit. We also made our animals sit, thinking that he intended performing salaah. He however told us that it was at this place that Rasulullaah ﷺ stopped to relieve himself and that he also wished to relieve himself there."[^3]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) used to go to a certain tree between Makkah and Madinah beneath which he would have his afternoon nap. He mentioned that (he did so because) Rasulullaah ﷺ used to do that.[^4]

Hadhrat Naafi narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) was extremely particular about following in the footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ. He would therefore note every spot where Rasulullaah ﷺ performed salaah (during journeys) and (was so particular about this that) even if Rasulullaah ﷺ ever dismounted beneath any tree, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) would care for the tree and pour water on its roots so that it should not dry up.[^5]
